description: Labelled retrieval questions over the frozen decks. `gold_slides` are the slides whose extracted text contains the answer. `answer_needles` are exact phrases from that text: a retrieved passage is answer-bearing when it contains any one of them. Because relevance is defined on source text, a chunking change cannot redefine correctness.
label_status: drafted by the coding assistant from the extracted deck text and machine-checked against it; pending owner verification
splits: dev is used to choose between configurations; heldout is reported once and never tuned on
matching: needles and passages are compared after Unicode NFKC normalization, case folding and whitespace collapsing
